earlier.title: Tidepool
earlier.blurb: Neural-network creatures evolve in a simulated tidepool.

earlier.title: Atlas of Elsewhere
earlier.blurb: Maps of invented islands with real physics and a generated language.

earlier.title: Terrarium
earlier.blurb: Plants, rabbits and foxes in a terminal ecosystem.

earlier.title: Gradus
earlier.blurb: A counterpoint composer that explains every note and sings it.

earlier.title: Let's Play God
earlier.blurb: A Linux god game with simulated tribes, wildlife and ecology (local only).

earlier.title: Rewind
earlier.blurb: A small language with a time-travelling debugger.

daily.title: Cronwise
daily.blurb: Explains cron expressions in English, lists next runs and maps a typical week, checked against an independent oracle.

daily.title: Tonal Ladder
daily.blurb: Colour ramps where any two steps k apart share the same WCAG contrast, checked by an independent Python oracle.

daily.title: Chladni Sand
daily.blurb: Sand on a virtual vibrating plate crawls to the nodal lines; modes checked against an independent eigenvalue oracle.

daily.title: Even Split
daily.blurb: Type who paid what and get the fewest payments that settle a group in exact cents, checked by an independent Python oracle.

daily.title: Stamp Lights
daily.blurb: A Lights-Out puzzle with a different stamp each time and an exact fewest-presses count, checked against a brute-force oracle.

daily.title: Overlap
daily.blurb: Enter a team's time zones and working hours and see every window when all are at work, exact across DST, checked against a minute-by-minute Python oracle.

daily.title: Sandpile Identity
daily.blurb: Draws the one sandpile that changes nothing when added, for any grid up to 101x101, and checks it live against an independent oracle.

daily.title: Regex Twins
daily.blurb: Type two regular expressions and learn exactly whether they match the same strings, or the shortest string that separates them, checked against JS RegExp and Python re.

daily.title: Tuning Fit
daily.blurb: Enter the pure ratios you care about and find which equal tuning (any number of steps, any repeating interval) fits them best, then hear pure against tempered; checked against an exact big-integer oracle.

daily.title: Knotwork
daily.blurb: Place walls on a grid and Celtic-knot strands bounce and weave; it counts the threads, can search for a single endless one, and is checked against a gcd law and an independent billiard oracle.

daily.title: Rankwise
daily.blurb: Enter how a group ranks its options and see who wins under six voting rules, where and why they disagree, with a head-to-head table; checked against an independent brute-force oracle.

daily.title: Strip Folds
daily.blurb: Write mountain and valley folds on a paper strip and see whether it folds flat, in how many ways, and its shape unfolded to right angles; checked against the published stamp-folding numbers and a brute-force oracle.

daily.title: Fair Rooms
daily.blurb: Flatmates bid on rooms and get an envy-free split of the rent that is best for the least-happy person, solved exactly; checked against an independent every-assignment vertex-enumeration oracle.

daily.title: Change Ringer
daily.blurb: Write a bell-ringing method in place notation, add bobs and singles, and see every row, one bell's blue line and whether the touch is true; or search for the true touches. Checked against an independent exhaustive oracle.

daily.title: Cut List
daily.blurb: Give it the pieces you need and the board lengths on sale (with prices if you like) and it finds the cheapest cutting plan, kerf included, proves nothing cheaper exists and draws every board; checked against an independent subset-DP oracle.

daily.title: Sparse Ruler
daily.blurb: The fewest marks a stick needs to measure every length (or only the lengths you list), proven minimal when the search can finish, with clickable marks and a map of who measures what; checked against an independent every-mark-set oracle.

daily.title: Sundial Maker
daily.blurb: Type your latitude and longitude, get a horizontal sundial to print at true size with hour lines, date curves and a gnomon to cut out, plus a live shadow and your watch correction; checked against an independent altitude/azimuth oracle.

daily.title: Harmonograph
daily.blurb: Four fading pendulums draw a curve that starts on its own: drag to re-pitch, press Surprise me, name the musical interval hiding in each shape, export SVG or share a link; checked against an independent RK4 integration.

daily.title: Tile Shifter
daily.blurb: Drag a dot on a tile and its twin edge moves too, so the whole plane stays tiled: an Escher-style tessellation toy with a breathing mode, SVG export and share links; checked against an independent winding-number coverage oracle.

daily.title: Ripple Tank
daily.blurb: A tank of water to poke: drop stones, draw walls and shallow patches, place a wave maker and watch waves reflect, bend and interfere; checked against independent physics oracles including two-source double-slit fringes.

daily.title: Lichen Garden
daily.blurb: Three lichens grow on one shared calendar: scrub years of seasons, plant three spores a day and come back to see what became of them; checked against an independent Python re-implementation and 10 engine mutants.

daily.title: Dice Duel
daily.blurb: Type two dice expressions like 2d20kh1+5 and d20+10 and see exactly which wins and how often, with distributions, target odds and a roll-it-yourself tally; checked against an independent brute-force enumeration of 360 expressions and 15 engine mutants.

daily.title: Gerrymander Lab
daily.blurb: Cut a grid of voters into districts yourself and see how your map compares with every possible map (10 to 451,206 of them), with a challenge to make the side with fewer voters win most seats; checked against the published cut counts, an independent bitmask-DP oracle and 17 engine mutants.
